# real data from the live DeltaDesk endpoints, Sat Sep 19 2026
You:   is it safe to LP NVDA on Robinhood Chain right now?
Bankr: CAUTION — NVDA/USDG: US market closed: fair value is Hyperliquid's
       internal price, Chainlink is frozen.
       Pool 222.4483 vs fair 222.2367 (-9.5 bp), regime WEEKEND_DARK.
       Conditions change Sun 07:50 PM ET (reopen window starts).

You:   when is it worst to LP NVDA?
Bankr: NVDA/USDG worst hours for LPs: Wed 09:00 ET (edge 0.33),
       Mon 09:00 ET (edge 0.25), Wed 17:00 ET (edge 0.26).
       (edge = fees ÷ value picked off; below 1, informed flow took more
       than LPs earned)

You:   how did my LP actually do?
Bankr: [tearsheet: fees vs informed flow vs IL vs gas, per $1k, with the
       reconciliation residual against on-chain collected fees]

setup: Install the skill with the button below
Keep a little USDC on Base in your Bankr wallet (calls cost $0.002–$0.05; failed calls are not charged)
Say: "is it safe to LP NVDA right now?"
Say: "how did my LP actually do?" for a full tearsheet (Robinhood Chain Uniswap or Aerodrome on Base)
